title: Radical Study Suggests Life on Earth Arose Twice
summary: A new scientific study proposes the controversial hypothesis that life on Earth may have independently emerged twice from non-living matter, challenging the long-held assumption of a single origin of life. The research suggests this could explain certain anomalies in the evolutionary tree of life and provides an alternative framework for understanding how LUCA (Last Universal Common Ancestor) gave rise to all known organisms.
problem_solved: Challenges the traditional single-origin-of-life hypothesis and attempts to explain why all life shares common characteristics despite potentially having multiple independent beginnings.
why_valuable: This hypothesis could fundamentally reshape our understanding of life's origins and provide insight into whether life emerging twice is unique to Earth or potentially common in the universe.
